state:
**Goal `goal-closeout`, Stage 4 (finished in place) is under way.** Stage 3 is done: `docs/agent/goal-decisions.md` names every goal in front of `goal-closeout`.

The `nvs-diagnostics`, `benches`, `nvs-test`, `nvs-db` and `nvs-ir` gap directories are closed for this goal. The other three `nvs-ir` gaps are owned by milestones M10 and M12. One `nvs-syntax` gap is left: `the-pipeline-bench-has-no-nested-twin`, a bench member, which is a different file set.

In `nvs-cli`, `nvs service --help`, each of its subcommands' help and the global `--config` and `--no-init` help are in the plain voice, pinned by `nvs_service_help_is_written_in_the_plain_voice` in `crates/nvs-cli/tests/one_binary.rs`. `nvs agent show` prints each `<!-- generated: <roster> -->` marker's rows from `nvs meta`'s document (`generated` in `crates/nvs-cli/src/agent.rs`), pinned in `crates/nvs-cli/tests/agent.rs`. Other subcommands' `--help` text was not swept and is still in the dense voice.

The floor check `the latest CI run on main succeeded for the code HEAD holds` is red only because `main` is many commits ahead of `origin/main` and the loop never pushes (`tools/nv/cmd/ci-green.ts`'s module doc). A person pushes. No session can close it.

`bun nv owners --closes goal-closeout` names the rest of the gaps, across many crates. Take them one directory at a time, smallest first. Stage 4 stops on `BLOCKED` only for "too large", which the goal's § *Stage 4* defines.

`bun nv import` is broken, because the rule index it reads was deleted. Goal `ci-green`'s floor check stays red until Stage 6. That is expected.
